enabledTip: When off, the floating toolbar keeps SiYuan's native behaviour (stays until the next click)
nearDistanceTip: The floating toolbar stays fully opaque within this distance; the farther away, the fainter it gets
farDistanceTip: The floating toolbar is closed immediately past this distance (no delay, no re-showing). At exactly this distance it is still visible, only faint
invalidDistance: Invalid distance: it must be a number
invalidDistanceNumber: "${field}" must be a number, but it is "${value}". Please fix it and save again.
invalidDistanceRange: "${field}" is out of range: you entered ${value}, but the allowed range is ${min} ~ ${max}. Please fix it and save again.
invalidDistanceOrder: "Fade starts beyond" must be smaller than "Close immediately beyond" (currently ${near} and ${far}). Please fix it and save again.
restartHint: Fully opaque within 20 → fainter with distance → closed immediately past 200. Changes apply instantly, no restart needed
